images.title: 97 as 100 minus 3
images.purpose: Show 97 × 25 as a full 100 by 25 rectangle with a thin 3 by 25 strip taken off.
images.composition: One wide rectangle centred, with its right strip separated by a dashed line, and the idea in one line below.
exact_structure: A rectangle 100 units wide and 25 units tall, drawn as a sketch.
The left part is teal #0072B2 and is labelled 97 along the top.
The thin right strip is vermilion #D55E00, labelled 3 along the top, separated by a dashed grey #6B7280 line.
Along the left side, a label 25. A label 100 under the whole width.
rejection: the thin strip drawn wider than the main part
a width label other than 97, 3 and 100
a plus sign in the final line
images.takeaway: Treat 97 as 100 minus 3, take the easy product, then subtract the small strip.
images.description: A 100 by 25 rectangle with a thin 3 by 25 strip marked off, leaving 97 by 25.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text on splitting a number.
images.teaching_notes: Look at the big rectangle first, then remove the small strip.

image_decisions.why: An area picture makes splitting a number close to 100 simple to trust.
